hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הָשֵׁ֤ב יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ אֶל חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב יָד֖/וֹ אֶל חֵיק֑/וֹ וַ/יּֽוֹצִאָ/הּ֙ מֵֽ/חֵיק֔/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֖בָה כִּ/בְשָׂרֽ/וֹ

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.
